subject: german
title: Opinions on Hobbies
welcome_lead: Saying you like, love or hate activities.
meta_desc: KS3 German: opinion verbs about hobbies.
final_note: Give your opinion on what you do.

walkthroughs.body_html: Ich mag Fussball = I like football. Ich liebe Schokolade = I love chocolate. Ich hasse Mathe = I hate maths.
To say you 'like to do' something, add gern: 'Ich spiele gern Tennis' = 'I like playing tennis'. Nicht gern = don't like to.
'My favourite sport' = mein Lieblingssport. 'My favourite hobby' = mein Lieblingshobby. Useful question: 'Was ist dein Lieblingshobby?'
